svg.aria-label: Cartoon: Staphylococcus aureus on a sheep blood agar plate says: I'm Staphylococcus aureus. I'm amazing. Haemophilus love to be around me. The Haemophilus colonies around it say: We are Haemophilus. We normally can't grow on sheep blood agar because it is missing key factors. The presence of Staphylococcus aureus produces those factors as a metabolic byproduct. What are the two key factors?
